title: The Game of Ten Thousand Years Ago
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji thought he had finally seen through everything, the true purpose of the Heavenly Eye revealed its ghastly smile at the end of fate—the next volume, the final battle will completely rewrite the rules of heaven and earth.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently trembled, and in that instant, Chen Ji felt his consciousness engulfed by a vast and boundless force, crossing the barrier of ten thousand years of time. It was a curtain woven from countless golden threads, with densely packed names inscribed upon it—some names shone bright as stars, while others were so dim they were barely discernible.

"This is... the complete roster of all participants in that game of ten thousand years ago." Mo Xiansheng's voice came from a distant place, carrying a near-reverent tremor, "It is also all the evidence the Heavenly Eye sought to erase."

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He saw Chen Xuan's name, prominently placed at the apex, alongside another name—that was his mother, Chen Shi. At this moment, all the mysteries that had troubled him for years finally had an almost insane answer.

The golden curtain slowly unfurled, and behind each name emerged a hazy vision. Chen Ji glimpsed the scene from eons past—within a chaotic void, hundreds of figures gathered around an enormous chessboard. What descended upon the board were not mere pieces, but the fates of countless souls.

"The Heavenly Eye did not exist from the beginning." Mo Xiansheng's voice resonated through Chen Ji's mind. "It formed from the resentments and obsessions that accumulated after each generation of prophets perished. Every possessor of the Tianji Record became its sustenance."

Chen Ji's fists unconsciously clenched. He saw his mother—a woman in plain white robes, standing beside Chen Xuan, cradling a page that radiated a faint glow. The aura emanating from that page bore an uncanny resemblance to the fragment of the Tianji Record pressed against his chest.

dialogue.content:
"Mother... she was always there." Chen Ji's voice came out hoarse, trembling with disbelief. "She didn't abandon us; she was—"

Before he could finish, a blinding radiance erupted from the golden curtain. A name detached from the tapestry and drifted toward Chen Ji—Chen Nian's name.

text.content:
Chen Nian's name glimmered with a faint golden aura, and the surrounding visions grew increasingly indistinct. Chen Ji glimpsed a young woman chained to an altar, her eyes sealed shut, surrounded by uncanny glyphs—a seal of Heavenly Fate's Key.

"Nian Nian..." Chen Ji's voice dropped low, tinged with peril. His darkening value quietly climbed. "What have the Holy Sect's people done to her?"

Mo Xiansheng paused silently for a moment before responding: "The players of that ancient game ten thousand years ago split into two factions. Chen Xuan and your mother chose to defy the Heavenly Eye, while the other side opted to merge with it. The Holy Sect is the heir of the latter faction. They took Chen Nian because they intend to—"

"Use her as a vessel." Chen Ji completed his sentence, a killing intent flickering menacingly in his eyes.

dialogue.content:
At that moment, an icy voice emanated from the depths of the void: "Do you see it now, Chen Ji? This is the truth you've been chasing. You believe you're orchestrating the world, yet in truth, you're merely a single chess piece on my board."

The golden curtain shattered abruptly, and countless names scattered like shooting stars into nothingness. Replacing it was a colossal eye—its pupil reflecting the entire cosmos, with Chen Ji's form appearing no larger than a speck of dust within it.

"Your mother exhausted every stratagem to fracture the Tianji Record into countless fragments, all to purchase you a sliver of survival. Yet she underestimated me." The Heavenly Eye's voice dripped with mockery. "Did you think obtaining the complete roster would change anything? The outcome of ten thousand years ago will replay today."

text.content:
Chen Ji gradually raised his head, confronting that cosmic eye beyond all realms. A subtle curve formed at the corner of his mouth—a smile. This expression caused the Heavenly Eye to pause momentarily. It had witnessed countless death throes, yet never before encountered such composure.

"So what?" Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet it resonated distinctly through the void. "You've told me all this—do you want me to despair? Or do you wish to witness me grovel and beg?"

He withdrew the Tianji Record fragment from his garments. The remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng within the fragment emitted a faint yet steadfast radiance: "What Chen Xuan and Mother couldn't accomplish ten thousand years ago doesn't guarantee my failure. Since you've chosen to manifest, that only proves one thing—you're afraid."

choice.prompt: Faced with the Heavenly Eye's pressure and mockery, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Directly mock the Heavenly Eye's bluffing, forcing it to reveal more of its hidden cards
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Obtain information on the Heavenly Eye's weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Heavenly Eye into acting prematurely

dialogue.content:
"Afraid?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, his voice echoing through the void. "Ten thousand years ago you employed the same tactics to defeat Chen Xuan. Now you use the same words to intimidate me. Do you think I'm him?"

The Heavenly Eye's pupil contracted sharply. In that instant, Chen Ji's words pierced like a blade, striking the wound it most wished to conceal.

choices.description: Pretend to waver, induce the Heavenly Eye to reveal more information about the two ending paths
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete information on the two ending paths
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by the Heavenly Eye

text.content:
Chen Ji suppressed his smile, and a carefully calibrated solemnity appeared between his brows. He lowered his gaze, his voice low: "You're right... in the end, Chen Xuan from ten thousand years ago couldn't escape your chess game either. How could I possibly—"

The Heavenly Eye released a low, cold laugh. Believing its prey had finally surrendered, it began an elaborate explanation: "Two paths—annihilation, or submission. Your mother chose annihilation, Chen Xuan chose to delay. The final outcome, as you can clearly see."

choices.description: Attempt to use Chen Nian's name as a conduit to contact his imprisoned sister
choices.visible_cost: Consume 15 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Establish a spiritual connection with Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the protective mechanism of the Heavenly Fate Lock

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji poured his consciousness into the floating name without hesitation. In that instant, a faint consciousness responded to him—it was Chen Nian's voice, young yet stubborn: "Brother... I sense you... Don't come save me, they will—"

The voice cut off abruptly. Chen Ji's eyes reddened, but he clenched his teeth and refused to let his emotions run wild. This single connection was his greatest gain at this moment.

text.content:
Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the Heavenly Eye slowly opened its massive pupil to its full might. The void trembled, and countless scenes flashed before Chen Ji's eyes like a carousel—two distinctly different paths of fate.

"See clearly, this is your future." The Heavenly Eye's voice resembled the judgment of heaven itself. "The first path—the path of destruction. You will gather all the fragments of the Tianji Record, igniting yourself with the cost of your Heavenly Fate Value, and perish together with me. But the price is, everyone around you will be sacrificed alongside you."

Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. He saw Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, even Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit, all turn to nothingness in that single battle.

"The second path—the path of submission." The Heavenly Eye's voice softened, yet carried a nauseating虚伪: "Surrender to me, and I shall grant you true power. You can avenge your mother, your sister can be saved, even... I can make you the new master of the Tianji Record, sharing the authority of this realm with me."

The scene shifted, and Chen Ji saw a completely different vision—he dressed in magnificent robes, seated regally beside the Heavenly Eye, gazing down at the countless mortals beneath. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, even Chen Nian, all lived safely under his protection.

"Isn't this... wonderful?" The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a soul-corrupting temptation.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji fell silent. This silence stretched unbearably through the void, and even the Heavenly Eye couldn't help but narrow its massive pupil.

After a moment, Chen Ji spoke. His voice was calm, yet carried a chilling certainty: "What you said sounds appealing. Unfortunately, you've miscalculated one crucial thing."

He lifted his gaze, staring directly into those transcendent eyes: "Whether destruction or submission—these are all choices you've presented. But have you ever considered—why must I play by your rules?"

The Heavenly Eye's pupil contracted sharply.

text.content:
Chen Ji raised the Tianji Record Fragment high above his head. The remnant spirit of Mo Xiansheng within the fragment suddenly burst forth with unprecedented radiance. Simultaneously, another object in Chen Ji's embrace began to resonate—a jade pendant engraved with the Chen family's bloodline mark, his mother's memento acquired from a certain secret realm.

"Ten thousand years ago, Mother split the Tianji Record into countless fragments precisely to embed a fatal flaw within you." Chen Ji's voice grew increasingly cold. "Did you think collecting the fragments was to restore the Tianji Record? No—it was to activate Mother's final contingency—the Fate Reversal Formation."

The golden curtain appeared once more, but this time, the names upon it began to rearrange. The Heavenly Eye's expression finally showed its first signs of wavering.

choice.prompt: The Fate Reversal Formation begins activation. Chen Ji must choose his next action:

choices.description: Immediately activate the Fate Reversal Formation, striking a fatal blow while the Heavenly Eye is shaken
choices.visible_reward: Weaken the Heavenly Eye's power by thirty percent

text.content:
Without hesitation, Chen Ji poured his entire consciousness into the Fate Reversal Formation. Golden light erupted toward the heavens, and countless erased names reappeared—those pioneers from ten thousand years ago who chose to oppose the Heavenly Eye. Their residual wills converged into a torrent, surging directly toward the massive pupil.

The Heavenly Eye let out a furious roar, and black "blood" flowed from its pupil for the first time. Its voice lost all composure: "You're mad! This will cause the entire Heavenly Dao to collapse!"

choices.description: Only partially activate the reversal formation's effects, preserving strength to respond to subsequent variables
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete activation method for the reversal formation
choices.risk_hint: May allow the Heavenly Eye to regain composure

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew seventy percent of his consciousness, allowing only a fraction of the formation's power to release. Although the golden light wasn't strong enough to gravely injure the Heavenly Eye, it successfully disrupted its rhythm.

Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind: "Well done, young master. The true activation method requires gathering three sacred relics—the Tianji Record Fragment, your mother's jade pendant, and..."

"And what?"

"Your sister's blood." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a solemn weight. "This is why the Holy Sect cultivated her as the Heavenly Fate Lock."

The Heavenly Eye finally recovered from its initial shock. Its pupil regained its icy authority, but Chen Ji acutely sensed—a hint of unprecedented wariness now flickered deep within those eyes.

"Interesting." The Heavenly Eye's voice recovered its composure, yet carried a chilling murderous intent. "You are more dangerous than your father and mother combined. But do you truly believe this threatens me?"

Countless cracks suddenly tore through the void, from which dense crowds of figures poured forth—these were the Fate Shackle Keepers raised by the Heavenly Eye, puppet cultivators it had controlled for millennia. Among them were even some faces familiar to Chen Ji—those sect elders believed to have perished, those legendary sages who supposedly ascended.

"Come then, Chen Ji." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried cruel delight. "Let me see how much your cleverness avails you against absolute power."

Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings. The oppressive aura emanating from those Fate Shackle Keepers nearly crushed his breath. The weakest among them all possessed Unity Splitting stage cultivation, and several had even touched the门槛 of Great Ascension. And he? Merely atrash unable to even stabilize his Golden Core stage.

Yet Chen Ji's lips curved into a faint smile. Such a smile, in the face of certain doom, appeared particularly stark.

dialogue.content:
"Are you certain you want to act here?" Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet clearly reached every being's ears. "Heavenly Eye, you should know better than anyone—this is the site of a chess match ten thousand years ago, where countless restrictions laid by Chen Xuan and my mother still linger."

His fingers gently brushed the Tianji Record Fragment: "Of course, I alone cannot defeat all of you. But if I were to activate the full power of the Tianji Record here... do you think my Heavenly Fate Value would deplete first, or would this entire realm collapse first?"

The Heavenly Eye's pupil contracted violently. Those Fate Shackle Keepers also stopped in unison, their eyes revealing instinctive fear.

text.content:
The void fell into an eerie silence. The Heavenly Eye and Chen Ji faced each other, neither making the first move. This standoff lasted a full incense stick's time, until finally the Heavenly Eye broke the silence first.

"Very well." Its voice carried suppressed fury. "Today I shall spare you. But remember, Chen Ji—however you struggle, the final outcome will never change. The chess game your mother and father could not escape from—you cannot escape either."

With those words, the massive pupil slowly dissipated. The dense ranks of Fate Shackle Keepers retreated like a receding tide, vanishing into the void's cracks.

Only when the Heavenly Eye's aura had completely vanished did Chen Ji slowly release his clenched grip on the Tianji Record. His forehead was covered in fine beads of sweat, his back garments long soaked through with cold perspiration. That confrontation seemed composed, yet every moment had depleted his spirit and Heavenly Fate Value.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit drifted out from the fragment, his expression complex as he gazed at Chen Ji: "Young master, your judgment just now was correct. Although the Heavenly Eye is powerful, its wariness of this site runs deep. The restrictions Chen Xuan and your mother laid here could truly harm it."

"But that's all there is to it." Chen Ji's voice was somewhat hoarse. "It retreated today because it isn't prepared. Next time, it won't give me a chance to speak."

choice.prompt: Crisis temporarily resolved. Chen Ji needs to organize his subsequent plans:

choices.description: Asking Mo Xiansheng for more details about the match ten thousand years ago, especially regarding mother's past
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining the complete past between mother and Chen Xuan
choices.risk_hint: May trigger memories Mo Xiansheng is unwilling to mention

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while, finally sighing deeply: "Very well, since it has come to this, telling you won't matter. Your mother... she was the destined inheritor chosen by the Tianji Record, and she and Chen Xuan were junior and senior siblings. Together they discovered the truth of the Heavenly Eye, together they embarked on the path of opposing fate."

"Then why did she leave that jade pendant? Why did she... leave us?" Chen Ji's voice tightened.

Mo Xiansheng's voice dropped lower: "Because she was the original designer of the Heavenly Fate Lock. Chen Nian wasn't accidentally captured by the Holy Sect—she was deliberately cultivated. Your mother used her own bloodline to weave the only shackle capable of restraining the Heavenly Eye."

choices.description: Discussing with Mo Xiansheng how to deal with the approaching final battle
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining key strategic hints for the final battle
choices.risk_hint: May have overlooked some important details

text.content:
Chen Ji forced himself to step back from the complex emotions, calmly beginning to analyze the situation: "Mo Xiansheng, to activate the Fate Reversal Array, I need to gather three relics. I already have several pages of the Tianji Record Fragment, mother's jade pendant is in my hands, and Niannian's blood..."

His gaze sharpened: "So no matter how the Holy Sect controls Niannian now, I must rescue her. Otherwise, it's all empty talk."

Mo Xiansheng nodded: "The young master speaks wisely. But the Holy Sect's old leader, Ling Yuan, has already submitted to the Heavenly Eye. He will stop at nothing to oppose you. In the next volume, you will inevitably face each other directly."

choices.description: Considering how to contact Ye Qing and Su Qingyao to prepare personnel for the final battle
choices.visible_reward: Sorting out the usable pieces among various forces

text.content:
Chen Ji began calculating the pieces in his hand: "Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, which is key to countering the Heavenly Eye's detection. Although Su Qingyao doesn't yet know the full truth, her trust in me is enough to have her stand on my side..."

He paused, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes: "And there's Han Lie. Though this guy is hopelessly stupid, his combat power truly is the top among the younger generation today. If I can convince him to cooperate temporarily..."

Mo Xiansheng said softly: "Han Lie's nature is proud. Getting him to cooperate with a 'waste' won't be easy."

A meaningful smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips: "That's why I need to find the right opportunity. Don't worry, I've never fought a battle without preparation."

As Chen Ji was sorting through his thoughts, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly shuddered violently. Within the golden light, a familiar figure slowly coalesced—it was Chen Nian's form, though just a vague light shadow, it made Chen Ji's heart tighten painfully.

"Brother..." Chen Nian's voice in the light shadow was faint, yet carried an unnoticeable trace of clarity, "I heard your voice... They thought they sealed me away, but I've been waiting..."

Chen Ji's eye rims slightly reddened: "Niannian, are you okay? Brother will definitely rescue you."

Chen Nian's light shadow shook her head: "There's no time, brother. The Holy Sect's ritual is about to be completed... In three days, I will become the vessel of the Heavenly Eye. But if you can activate the Fate Reversal Array before then, you can destroy its power from within."

dialogue.content:
"No!" Chen Ji's voice abruptly rose, "I will never trade your life for any victory. There must be another way—"

Chen Nian's light shadow revealed a bitter smile: "Brother, don't you understand yet? The Heavenly Fate Lock itself was designed with my life as the cost. Either sacrifice me to break the seal, or watch the Heavenly Eye descend completely. The choice mother made ten thousand years ago now falls to me."

Her voice gentled: "But I don't regret it. Because I know, brother, you will definitely find that third path where everyone lives. You've never disappointed us, have you?"

The light shadow slowly faded, leaving only Chen Ji alone in the void, fists clenched, fingernails digging deep into his palms.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng watched Chen Ji's back, rare in not disturbing him. He could sense the emotions surging within this young man—anger, grief, unwillingness, and a hint of obsessive determination.

After a long while, Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly turned around. His eyes were still red, but in those eyes, a cold flame had rekindled.

"The third path." His voice was soft, yet carried unwavering certainty, "Niannian is right. I will never let anyone sacrifice themselves, especially not my family."

He tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his chest, his gaze falling upon the distant void: "Three days... that's enough. If the Heavenly Eye wants to play chess, then I'll comply. The path that mother and Chen Xuan couldn't complete ten thousand years ago, I will finish."

A faint smile curved his lips—that smile held no despair, only a chilling calm and certainty that made one's heart tremble. This was Chen Ji's smile, the smile of a discarded genius who calculated every move and never fought unprepared battles.

In the void, Chen Ji took one last look at those gradually fading golden threads—those were the names of all the players from ten thousand years ago, also his mother's legacy. He gently touched the jade pendant in his chest, where the Chen family bloodline mark seemed to pulse warmly.

"Mother, can you see this?" Chen Ji murmured, "Your son will not repeat your fate. Neither destruction nor submission is Chen Ji's style."

He turned and set foot on the journey back. Behind him, in the void, a pair of eyes seemed to be watching him—gaze holding both wariness and anticipation. The Heavenly Eye's voice echoed in the void, carrying an eerie smile: "Interesting... Chen Xuan and Chen's son, truly different. Very well, I await your arrival. In three days, let us end this ten-thousand-year match on this chessboard."

The gears of fate have already begun to turn. Chen Ji is about to face the greatest challenge of his life. And this time, he is no longer fighting alone—behind him stands his mother's legacy, Mo Xiansheng's protection, Chen Nian's trust, and the souls of all who have been oppressed by the Heavenly Eye.
